description: Analog (and full-custom digital final mux) partition: xschem schematics+symbols and the netlists klt netlist derives from them. Freshness is gated in CI by signoff/derived_stamps.py (hash tripwire, no xschem/PDK on the runner); the real regeneration check (klt netlist --check, xschem 3.4.4, gf180mcuD) is run by `derived_stamps.py --refresh` before any re-stamp. See signoff/README.md.
